name: DNS Filtering
description: Self-hosted DNS filtering service with per-device filtering profiles
author: System Developer

settings.name: dns_filtering_dns_api_key
settings.label: ScrollDaddy DNS API Key
settings.helptext: API key for the DNS server management endpoints.

settings.name: dns_filtering_dns_server_ip
settings.label: Server Public IP
settings.helptext: e.g. 45.56.103.84 — shown in the Windows and router setup instructions.

messages.pattern: An IPv4 address, like 45.56.103.84. An IPv6 address goes in the IPv6 box.

settings.name: dns_filtering_dns_server_ipv6
settings.label: Server Public IPv6
settings.helptext: e.g. 2600:3c03::f03c:91ff:fe24:1 — optional. The server's access key works from this address as well as its IPv4 one.

messages.pattern: An IPv6 address, like 2600:3c03::1. An IPv4 address goes in the IPv4 box.

settings.name: dns_filtering_dns_secondary_internal_url
settings.label: Secondary Internal URL
settings.helptext: e.g. http://10.0.0.2:8053. Leave blank for single-server mode.

settings.name: dns_filtering_dns_secondary_api_key
settings.label: Secondary DNS API Key
settings.helptext: Leave blank to use the primary API key.

settings.name: dns_filtering_dns_secondary_server_ip
settings.label: Secondary Server Public IP
settings.helptext: e.g. 172.16.0.2 — shown in the setup instructions when configured.

messages.pattern: An IPv4 address, like 172.16.0.2. An IPv6 address goes in the IPv6 box.

settings.name: dns_filtering_dns_secondary_server_ipv6
settings.label: Secondary Server Public IPv6
settings.helptext: Optional. The secondary server's access key works from this address as well as its IPv4 one.

messages.pattern: An IPv6 address, like 2600:3c03::1. An IPv4 address goes in the IPv4 box.

settings.name: dns_filtering_resolver_key_primary
settings.helptext: The id of the primary DNS server's key for the resolver_snapshot action. Written by the DNS server access panel.

settings.name: dns_filtering_resolver_key_secondary
settings.helptext: The id of the secondary DNS server's key for the resolver_snapshot action. Written by the DNS server access panel.
